# Wizard
[color=lightblue][bold]Wizards[/bold][/color] are unique individuals who have access to powers that defy scientific principles. They are part of the Space Wizard Federation, who have their own interests. They have one objective - to simply [color=red][bold]cause havoc and destruction to the station[/bold][/color]. Unlike the [textlink="The Syndicate" link="Traitors"], however, wizards do not receive any outside assistance from the Federation. Outside of the wizard's spells and/or their apprentice, the wizard is completely on their own.
## Objectives Alright look, as a fellow wizard all you gotta do is [color=green]survive[/color]. You don't need to go on their silly evacuation shuttle. Apart from that, we can pretty much do anything we want. Remember, the more chaos you cause - the more happy our federation will be. Oh and one more thing, [color=red]Mass sabotage[/color] is something you can do, but it's a little frowned upon and kinda boring, magic is so much more fun.
## Your Magical Equipment When you first wake up in your den, you will find several special items to use, either on you or around your den : - [bold]Wizard's Grimoire[/bold]: Now this amazing piece of technology is where you will get all of your beautiful magic spells and trinkets, it’s my favorite thing they give us. You’ll start with ten “WizCoins” to buy whatever your heart desires while still in your little den. When buying spells, MAKE SURE TO CHECK IF THEY SAID THEY AREN'T REFUNDABLE!! I fell for this mistake once and got myself scammed, all spells are refundable unless they specifically say otherwise. Also, recently new technology was developed where only you can open your grimoire, so don't worry about other people taking the federations secrets. Last but not least thing that this can do is [textlink="enchant" link="Enchanting"] using your wizard altar. - [bold]Wizard Garb[/bold]: Alright, when you first wake up there will be a table near you, I think I remember it being south. There will be a variety of differently coloured robes for you to replace your ugly default wear. The [color=lightblue]Wizard's Hat and Robes[/color] provide decent protection as well as allow you to cast most of the spells. If you lose these, you better be more worried about what happens when you get back to the federation than the crew, and your objectives will be much harder to do. If you for some reason want some more armor you can go for [color=blue]Magus Armor[/color] (that does not allow you to cast robed spells) located in the middle room or for [color=purple]Wizard Hardsuit[/color] available in your grimoire. Apparently I have to go over this since it’s not obvious, but all of our outwear is fireproof and can partially protect you from extreme temperatures (the hardsuit has full space protection), so you can be on fire if you’re stupid and live for longer than normal. - [bold]Scroll of Teleportation[/bold]: This scroll that they give us has [color=yellow]4 uses[/color], but only one use if you're an apprentice…. they deserve that, I hate apprentices. You’ll have to use this as your ONE WAY trip to the station unless you take the teleport spell, but the remaining uses can be useful if you start to get robusted by security and have your spells on cooldown. - [bold]Magic Mirror[/bold]: This weird mirror is not your normal mirror, you can somehow use it to change everything about you. Your name, species and your physical appearance. We never have to go to the gym again. - [bold]Mugwort Tea[/bold]: Now it has become tradition for higher ups to leave tea for people. This cup of mugwort will slowly heal anyone from our federation of [color=lightgreen]all damage types[/color] over time. Its completely free so be sure to grab it if you can drink and process chemicals. - [bold]Pondering Orb[/bold]: A stationary [color=cyan]pondering orb[/color] that allows us to remotely spy on people (in your case, whatever station they task you with) and sometimes communicate with the dead.
## You Are the Wizard, the Wizard Is You
Because of how low the budget is to have fun, you are just one person versus the entire crew, your job will not be easy. I can safely say from my experience that once the crew sees you, they will be out for your blood, no matter what you do. You can’t be stupid with what spells you pick, you need to stay alive while causing chaos. Also one more tip, we all HATE homophobic wizards. If you see a homophobic wizard, don't even bother saying anything and just KILL them. In the next segment are some pointers I thought of off the top of my head when using your coins: - I [bold]heavily[/bold] recommended that you take at least 1 mobility spell with you. While you have all of your magical spells and items, you still have no access and can often get stuck (yes this has happened to me).Having access to a spell which can whisk you away from danger and let you easily move around the station will significantly improve your odds of surviving. Some of my favorite choices for mobility spells are [bold]Ethereal Jaunt[/bold], [bold]Blink[/bold] and [bold]Teleport[/bold]. [bold]Rod Form[/bold] can also be a good mix of mobility and offence, but be careful you don’t throw yourself into space with no means of getting back onto the station, this has happened before. - Now picking [bold]bind Soul[/bold] is something you should almost 100% do when it’s your first time attacking a station, as it will revive you some time after death to wherever you stored your bound item. Be warned that if the crew finds the item and destroys it, you will not revive from death. You will also resurrect with only some black wizard robes on you, so any items you acquired or bought will be lost unless you're making use of [bold]Instant Summons[/bold]. - I have seen many wizards take the magical items and artefacts offered to them because of how fun they are to use,then lose their items to a clown who slipped them, they WILL try to take your items and use it against you. Stick with spells if you do not want to die to your own items or invest in the [bold]Instant Summons[/bold] spell to bind an item to you so you can recall it back into your hands if it gets stolen. - While we start off alone in our dens, you can invest your WizCoins into buying [bold]apprentices[/bold], who can focus on keeping you alive or causing some mayhem of their own. Remember that some spells (such as [bold]The Traps[/bold], [bold]Tesla Blast[/bold], [bold]Magic Missile[/bold] and many others) may hurt or target your apprentice so choose your loadout wisely. - One of my favorite things to do is upgrading spells, you can spend more coins on spells to lower their cooldown or make them stronger. You can upgrade spells up to FIVE times that support upgrading, however doing so will probably make you a one trick pony. - Something that I suggest looking for once you board the station are an ID card (the more access the better, but any will help) and a medical kit for healing. Having an ID means you don’t need to waste spell charges getting through maintenance doors and the medical kit will become highly useful once the [bold]mugwort tea[/bold] runs out. You can also get an ID card with accesses by acquiring special bundles from the grimoire (only available after purchasing certain spells). - If you want a lot of spell versatility for a low cost, consider taking the [bold]Magic Wand[/bold] and the [bold]Charge[/bold] spell. Normally the wand can only be used so many times before it is drained but charge will restore a portion of its uses, heavily increasing its lifespan. Take note that wand can only be recharged so many times before being rendered useless, and that the number of uses you replenish will gradually get lower each time it is charged. In addition anyone can use your wand if you lose it, so be very careful when and where you use it, but only those powerful enough (you) can change the modes it has.
